import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
export const roles = ['PRESETS', 'ALL_SCENARIOS', 'createIntroState', 'createScenarioState',
  'createScenarioVehicle', 'cloneState', 'step', 'SHIP', 'SUPER_HEAVY', 'CATCH',
  'createCatchPose', 'writeCatchPose', 'runBoosterAutopilot', 'toggleAutoLand',
  'starBaseXPos', 'heatLimit', 'DT'];
export function assertExternalMapRoute(code, mapName) {
  assert.equal(typeof code, 'string'); assert.match(mapName, /^[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+\.map$/);
  let body = code;
  if (body.endsWith('\r\n')) body = body.slice(0, -2);
  else if (body.endsWith('\n')) body = body.slice(0, -1);
  assert.equal(body.slice(body.lastIndexOf('\n') + 1), '//# sourceMappingURL=' + mapName);
  assert.equal(code.split('sourceMappingURL=').length, 2);
}
function identifier(node) { assert.equal(node.type, 'Identifier'); return node.name; }
export function facadeBindings(ast, chunkName) {
  assert.equal(ast.type, 'Program'); assert.equal(ast.body.length, 2);
  const [imports, exports] = ast.body;
  assert.equal(imports.type, 'ImportDeclaration'); assert.equal(imports.source.value, './' + chunkName);
  assert.equal(exports.type, 'ExportNamedDeclaration'); assert.equal(exports.source, null);
  assert.equal(exports.declaration, null);
  const imported = new Map();
  for (const item of imports.specifiers) {
    assert.equal(item.type, 'ImportSpecifier');
    const local = identifier(item.local), target = identifier(item.imported);
    assert(!imported.has(local)); imported.set(local, target);
  }
  const bindings = {};
  for (const item of exports.specifiers) {
    assert.equal(item.type, 'ExportSpecifier');
    const role = identifier(item.exported), local = identifier(item.local);
    assert(Object.hasOwn(Object.fromEntries(imported), local));
    assert(!Object.hasOwn(bindings, role)); bindings[role] = imported.get(local);
  }
  assert.deepEqual(Object.keys(bindings).sort(), [...roles].sort());
  assert.equal(imported.size, roles.length);
  assert.equal(new Set(exports.specifiers.map(item => identifier(item.local))).size, imported.size);
  return bindings;
}
export function mappedChunkExports(ast, bindings) {
  const exported = new Map();
  for (const item of ast.body) {
    assert.notEqual(item.type, 'ImportDeclaration', 'This pinned simulation closure has no external/static imports');
    assert.notEqual(item.type, 'ExportAllDeclaration', 'Re-export dependencies are outside this closed graph');
    if (item.type !== 'ExportNamedDeclaration') continue;
    assert.equal(item.source, null); assert.equal(item.declaration, null);
    for (const specifier of item.specifiers) {
      const name = identifier(specifier.exported); assert(!exported.has(name));
      exported.set(name, identifier(specifier.local));
    }
  }
  const stack = [ast]; let visited = 0;
  while (stack.length) {
    const node = stack.pop(); assert(++visited <= 200000);
    if (!node || typeof node !== 'object') continue;
    assert.notEqual(node.type, 'ImportExpression', 'Dynamic imports unsupported by this exact closed graph');
    if (node.type === 'Identifier') assert(!['eval', 'require', 'Function'].includes(node.name));
    if (node.type === 'MemberExpression' && node.computed && node.property?.type === 'Literal') {
      assert(!['eval', 'require', 'Function'].includes(node.property.value));
    }
    if (node.type === 'CallExpression' || node.type === 'NewExpression') {
      if (node.callee?.type === 'Identifier') assert(!['eval', 'require', 'Function'].includes(node.callee.name));
    }
    for (const value of Object.values(node)) {
      if (Array.isArray(value)) stack.push(...value);
      else if (value && typeof value === 'object') stack.push(value);
    }
  }
  const concrete = {};
  for (const [role, name] of Object.entries(bindings)) {
    assert(exported.has(name), 'Facade binding missing from actual mapped chunk');
    concrete[role] = { chunkExport: name, local: exported.get(name) };
  }
  return concrete;
}
export function pureRouteControls() {
  const route = '//# sourceMappingURL=simulation-CN0-W409.js.map';
  const map = 'simulation-CN0-W409.js.map';
  const outcomes = [];
  for (const [name, ending] of [['none', ''], ['LF', '\n'], ['CRLF', '\r\n']]) {
    assertExternalMapRoute('export {};\n' + route + ending, map); outcomes.push({ name, accepted: true });
  }
  for (const [name, code] of [
    ['wrong-name', '//# sourceMappingURL=wrong.map'],
    ['duplicate', route + '\n' + route], ['inline', 'export {}; ' + route],
    ['trailing-code', route + '\nexport {};'], ['extra-blank-line', route + '\n\n'],
  ]) {
    assert.throws(() => assertExternalMapRoute(code, map), { code: 'ERR_ASSERTION' });
    outcomes.push({ name, rejected: true });
  }
  return outcomes;
}

// Public parser supplied by the independently pinned runner; text is never evaluated.
export function pureClosureControls(parseAst) {
  const chunkName = 'simulation-CN0-W409.js';
  const imports = roles.map((_, i) => 'e' + i + ' as b' + i).join(', ');
  const exports = roles.map((role, i) => 'b' + i + ' as ' + role).join(', ');
  const facade = 'import {' + imports + '} from "./' + chunkName + '"; export {' + exports + '};';
  const chunk = roles.map((_, i) => 'const e' + i + ' = ' + i + ';').join('') +
    'export {' + roles.map((_, i) => 'e' + i).join(',') + '};';
  const bindings = facadeBindings(parseAst(facade), chunkName);
  mappedChunkExports(parseAst(chunk), bindings);
  const outcomes = [{ name: 'exact-static-facade-and-closed-chunk', accepted: true }];
  const deny = (name, run) => {
    assert.throws(run, { code: 'ERR_ASSERTION' }); outcomes.push({ name, rejected: true });
  };
  deny('facade-side-effect-statement', () => facadeBindings(parseAst(facade + 'console.log(1);'), chunkName));
  deny('facade-foreign-target', () => facadeBindings(parseAst(facade.replace(chunkName, 'foreign.js')), chunkName));
  deny('facade-missing-role', () => { const ast = parseAst(facade); ast.body[1].specifiers.pop(); facadeBindings(ast, chunkName); });
  deny('facade-duplicate-role', () => { const ast = parseAst(facade); ast.body[1].specifiers[1].exported.name = ast.body[1].specifiers[0].exported.name; facadeBindings(ast, chunkName); });
  deny('chunk-missing-binding', () => { const ast = parseAst(chunk); ast.body.at(-1).specifiers.pop(); mappedChunkExports(ast, bindings); });
  for (const [name, addition] of [
    ['chunk-static-import', 'import x from "./foreign.js";'],
    ['chunk-export-all', 'export * from "./foreign.js";'],
    ['chunk-dynamic-import', 'const extra = import("./foreign.js");'],
    ['chunk-sequence-eval', 'const extra = (0, eval)("1");'],
    ['chunk-member-Function', 'const extra = globalThis.Function("return 1");'],
    ['chunk-computed-Function', 'const extra = globalThis["Function"]("return 1");'],
    ['chunk-direct-require', 'const extra = require("foreign");'],
  ]) deny(name, () => mappedChunkExports(parseAst(chunk + addition), bindings));
  return outcomes;
}
